story: AquaPure Water Filtration Services L.L.C. started in 2010 with two technicians, one van and a simple observation: plenty of companies were happy to sell UAE residents a water filter, and almost none of them came back to service it.

Fifteen years later that is still the whole business model. We install systems properly, we keep a record of every cartridge in every property we look after, and we call our customers before the filters are due rather than waiting for the water to taste bad.

Today mobile teams operate out of Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah with scheduled routes covering the northern Emirates — more than 12,000 households and businesses on our books, most of them from referrals.

values.title: Honest recommendations
values.body: We test your water and recommend what the reading justifies — nothing more. If your existing system just needs a cartridge, we will say so.

values.title: Aftercare that continues
values.body: The install is the beginning, not the end. We track your service dates and contact you before the filters are due, for as long as you stay with us.

values.title: Technicians, not salespeople
values.body: The person at your door is a trained plumber and filtration technician who can diagnose and fix the problem on the spot.

values.title: Genuine parts only
values.body: Original cartridges, membranes and pumps sourced through authorised channels — never grey-market copies that fail within months.

milestones.title: Founded in Dubai
milestones.body: Started as a two-technician operation servicing apartments in Deira and Bur Dubai.

milestones.title: Abu Dhabi branch
milestones.body: Opened a second base to cover the capital and Al Ain with same-day response.

milestones.title: Commercial division
milestones.body: Began designing and maintaining RO plants for restaurants, clinics and labour accommodation.

milestones.title: All 7 Emirates
milestones.body: Completed northern Emirates coverage with scheduled routes to RAK, Fujairah and UAQ.

milestones.title: 12,000+ customers
milestones.body: Over 12,000 households and businesses on our books, with a 4.9/5 average service rating.
